7607370817160121608.desc: ⬆️ Follow @discover_travel_japan for more Japan Travel Ideas!! 🇯🇵Your Ultimate 5-Day Tokyo Itinerary for First-Timers (The Refresh!) 🗼✨ Tokyo is a city that truly has it all – from bustling districts and serene gardens to cutting-edge tech and timeless traditions. This itinerary is packed with iconic sights, unique experiences, and of course, delicious eats! Save this list now and plan your dream trip! < 5 DAYS IN TOKYO THE BEST ITINERARY > Day 1: 📍 Shinjuku □Tokyo Metropolitan Building (free observation decks; evening projection art) □Kabukicho Tower □Shinjuku Golden Gai (New! - Historic, atmospheric maze of tiny bars) □Omoide Yokocho (izakayas) Day 2: 📍 Harajuku & Shibuya □Meiji Shrine □Takeshita Street (kawaii fashion, street food, thrifting, animal cafes) □Omotesando Street □Shibuya Crossing □Hachiko (nearby: 3D Dog billboard) □Shibuya Sky (beautiful at sunset) Day 3: 📍 Asakusa & Ueno & Akihabara □Ueno Ameyoko □Sensoji-Temple □Nakamise Street □Kappabashi Street (knives, kitchen items) □Tokyo Skytree □Akihabara (anime, game, manga, electronics, maid cafe) Day 4: 📍 Tsukiji & Ginza & Tokyo & Odaiba □Tsukiji Outer Market (☝️ get there early before the crowd) □East Gardens of the Imperial Palace (New! - Free access to the former Edo Castle grounds) □Azabudai Hills □Tokyo Tower (Go up for views, or view it from Shiba Park) □Odaiba (Gundham statue, shopping malls) □TeamLab Borderless Day 5: Day Trip □Mount Fuji or □Disney Resort* or □Hakone (hot spring onsen) or □Kamakura (oceanside train; secluded temples) or □Yokohama (cup noodle museum) or  * ⚠️ for those marked with * booking is recommended ✨    #tokyo #japantravel #japantrip #japanguide #fyp
